platform_core.competitor_gap: Enterprise platforms expose service ownership, runtime SLOs, incident/DR state and dependency maps instead of static navigation only.
platform_core.rule: Every production-facing service/module must have owner, SLO, dependency, deployment, DR and runtime readiness metadata before production promotion.
platform_core.acceptance: CI rejects missing owner/SLO/DR metadata; staging acceptance must prove runtime health and backup freshness.
platform_core.external_dependency: managed staging topology and operator DR rehearsal

security.competitor_gap: Leading IAM stacks provide corporate OIDC, device posture, phishing-resistant auth, SCIM/lifecycle and access review evidence.
security.rule: No module may claim production security without corporate OIDC/workload identity, device trust where required, lifecycle revocation and access-review evidence.
security.acceptance: Repository guards keep browser authority denied; production gate requires real issuer/JWKS/audience/claims and stale-token revocation proof.
security.external_dependency: corporate identity provider, device attestation service, SCIM/lifecycle source

eay_ai_core.competitor_gap: Enterprise AI platforms expose evals, model registry, observability, canary/promotion and rollback evidence at runtime.
eay_ai_core.rule: AI behaviors must be source-grounded, eval-gated, observable and promotion-controlled; no model/tool production claim without runtime evidence.
eay_ai_core.acceptance: CI verifies no ungoverned tool or model promotion; staging requires signed eval, canary and rollback evidence.

jarvis.competitor_gap: Governed conversational BI products answer from semantic/live data authority and expose traceable queries and action workflows.
jarvis.rule: Jarvis KPI answers must use approved tenant semantic definitions and governed data sources; missing live evidence must fail closed.
jarvis.acceptance: Orders V2 remains blocked until authorized production BigQuery identity, INFORMATION_SCHEMA, tenant discriminator and live zero-leak proof pass.

repository_intelligence.competitor_gap: Code intelligence leaders provide instant code graph, ownership, impact analysis and dependency/license visibility.
repository_intelligence.rule: Repository adoption requires exact upstream/ref/commit/tree/blob/license provenance and owner/impact metadata; unresolved archives stay PENDING.
repository_intelligence.acceptance: CI rejects invented repo identities, SPDX-less external verified licenses and unresolved-source ADOPT decisions.
repository_intelligence.external_dependency: exact archive hashes and license review

kpi_insight_analytics.competitor_gap: Modern metric layers provide proactive anomaly/root-cause/subscription/action flows, not frontend-computed dashboard truth.
kpi_insight_analytics.rule: KPI surfaces must consume server-authoritative metric contracts and tenant glossary semantics; no frontend formula truth.
kpi_insight_analytics.acceptance: CI rejects frontend-owned KPI formulas; production activation requires live governed data proof for each metric family.
kpi_insight_analytics.external_dependency: governed data source activation per KPI family

planogram.competitor_gap: Space-planning leaders optimize store-specific assortment, financial space, execution compliance and physical layout evidence.
planogram.rule: Planogram optimizer cannot publish production placement until approved dimensions, images, Store DNA, fixture geometry/capacity and aisle evidence exist.
planogram.acceptance: CI must fail closed on estimated dimensions; field acceptance requires measured physical master and execution-compliance sample.
planogram.external_dependency: approved SKU dimensions and measured Store DNA/fixtures

workforce.competitor_gap: WFM leaders combine demand forecasting, skill-aware scheduling, preferences, fairness, compliance, live attendance and intraday replanning.
workforce.rule: Workforce scheduling must separate demand truth from assignment and compare required work to effective skill capacity plus KPI/backlog pressure.
workforce.acceptance: CI proves bad KPI with enough capacity does not recommend more labor; field gate requires real OIDC/device/GPS/attendance pilot.
workforce.external_dependency: corporate OIDC, physical devices, real roster/attendance files

hiring_recruitment.competitor_gap: ATS leaders include CRM, structured scorecards, interview scheduling, candidate experience and funnel/quality-of-hire analytics.
hiring_recruitment.rule: Hiring must remain one Employee Master lifecycle and measure hire quality through first roster, Academy and operational retention/performance where available.
hiring_recruitment.acceptance: CI preserves Norm→Candidate→Approval→Hire→Employee Master→Roster and exit revocation; pilot requires real HR files and notification delivery.
hiring_recruitment.external_dependency: HR/3rd-party recruitment workflow and real notification channel

inventory.competitor_gap: WMS/handheld leaders provide managed scanners, offline queues, directed tasks, replenishment, exception handling and device fleet controls.
inventory.rule: Inventory production acceptance requires native managed terminal, signed build, MDM, OIDC, Zebra/DataWedge and offline/replay proof; web is not a terminal substitute.
inventory.acceptance: CI rejects managed-release without signing secrets; field gate requires real Zebra scanner and MDM deployment evidence.
inventory.external_dependency: corporate keystore, MDM, Zebra/DataWedge, production TLS endpoint

dockos.competitor_gap: Dock/yard leaders offer carrier self-service, gate/driver flows, yard map, dwell clocks, scorecards and ETA-driven dock assignment.
dockos.rule: DockOS must remain standalone but require corporate OIDC, signed gateway, real PO source, SMTP and supplier/DC pilot before production readiness.
dockos.acceptance: CI keeps concurrency/replay/DR green; staging gate requires real gateway rotation, BigQuery PO identity and SMTP retry/dead-letter evidence.
dockos.external_dependency: corporate gateway, BigQuery PO identity, SMTP and supplier pilot

budget_intelligence.competitor_gap: Enterprise planning leaders provide driver-based budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenarios, allocations, SoD and reconciliation workflows.
budget_intelligence.rule: Budget can run standalone from finance authority; operational modules may enrich drivers but cannot replace finance-owner source-of-truth and reconciliation.
budget_intelligence.acceptance: CI keeps RLS/SoD contracts; production gate requires finance-source mapping, reconciliation and finance-owner UAT sign-off.
budget_intelligence.external_dependency: real finance source and finance owner UAT

academy.competitor_gap: Learning leaders provide skills graph, proficiency, recommendations, labs/simulations, collaborative authoring and outcome analytics.
academy.rule: Academy must remain standalone and evolve to role→skill→proficiency→learning→assessment→operational outcome feedback without weakening media integrity.
academy.acceptance: CI keeps watched-time/checkpoint/media-token isolation; production gate requires storage/transcode/HLS/CDN and 1200-concurrent delivery evidence.
academy.external_dependency: real media plane, CDN, content, OIDC and load test

field_intelligence.competitor_gap: Field execution/form leaders support smart targeting, missions, offline capture, barcode/photo/GPS evidence, reminders, rework and command-center completion.
field_intelligence.rule: Field Intelligence must ask the physical world questions through server-authoritative targeting, evidence, reminder/escalation and verified truth, not generic form storage.
field_intelligence.acceptance: CI proves tenant/location scope, frozen target snapshots, evidence state machine, offline replay protection, reminder routing and Core API surface.
field_intelligence.external_dependency: managed mobile/scanner devices and pilot locations for field evidence

audit.competitor_gap: Audit/execution tools offer configurable inspections, scoring, corrective actions, evidence, scheduling, follow-up and immutable history.
audit.rule: Audit module will reuse Field targeting/evidence/reminders and platform audit primitives; detailed question model remains deferred until discovery, no guessed workflow.
audit.acceptance: No Audit production feature may be admitted without approved question taxonomy, scoring, corrective-action and evidence governance contract.
audit.external_dependency: AuditNow-style product discovery and customer audit templates

shared_services.competitor_gap: Best enterprise SaaS platforms enforce localization, accessibility, notifications, audit, universal search, preferences and operability consistently.
shared_services.rule: Every module surface must keep 10-language/RTL/accessibility/error-empty-offline semantics and use shared notification/audit/identity services.
shared_services.acceptance: CI rejects route/catalog/i18n/accessibility coverage gaps; production gate requires real-user/device acceptance for critical workflows.
